text:
felix: Heads-up: p99 on latency dashboard for /v1/generate spiked ~150ms in ap-south after we changed spill routing logic. p50/p95 flat. Small requests only.
tara: saw it. The dashboard's blended pctl line moved, but per-variant traces point to rdw-gpt-q4_mini_batch.
oscar: timeline: spill routing "overflow-to-fallback" rolled to 30% at 14:12. telemetry-bot: rollout canary-2026-03-23T14:12 -> 30%.
felix: quick query I ran: ```SELECT percentile(lat_ms,50), percentile(lat_ms,95), percentile(lat_ms,99), count(*) FROM latency WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND env='ap-south' GROUP BY model_variant,routing_policy```
tara: raw counts: q4_mini_batch=290, q3_base=5200. If our dashboard merges tdigests unweighted, small-variant tail will bias blended p99.
oscar: checked rollup metadata: "merged_sketches":true, "merged_count":null. That looks off.
telemetry-bot: PR queued: #900 "emit merged_count and perform weighted tdigest merges".
console-ux: short-term UX: adding provenance badge to latency panels and a sample-count badge in the legend. Also adding a temporary split-by-routing filter.
eng-oncall: mitigation options: reduce spill routing to 5% or scale fallback pool. Which do we prefer?
oscar: reduce to 5% now, scale if spike remains. I'll push the change.
tara: also check fallback pool queue depth + batch-fill timeout. If kernel waits for batch, small requests can get extra latency.
felix: action items: oscar -> dial canary to 5% now; oscar -> gather queue depth metrics; tara -> review telemetry PR and add unit tests for unequal-count merge; console-ux -> push provenance badge; felix -> annotate dashboard with canary timeline.
felix: filing INC-1300 (p99 blended spike during spillover canary). Tagging @eng-oncall. :memo:
